correctness.rationale: For stationary-uniform initial heading and d>0, the Fourier generator has eigenvalues −µ_j with µ_j=j²d+λ(1−c_j)−ijω. Analytic perturbation of the simple zero eigenvalue yields S2=v² a/(a²+Ω²) and a fourth-rate depending only on µ1,µ2. Independent exact SymPy rationalization matches the displayed fourth-rate numerator and both optimized branches. The optimum a=max(d,Ω), unique if c1<1; S4 is negative at a=Ω and at a=d with Ω≤d. Independent positive nonoptimal example λ=20 gives S4≈2.07067326917×10⁻⁵, versus λ*=1 negative ≈−0.0453312637. Uniform initial heading, symmetric angle law and fixed nonzero d are explicit hypotheses.

originality.rationale: Olsen–Löwen 2024 works in exactly the chiral-turn model but optimizes only second displacement moments/diffusion. Villa-Torrealba et al. compute kurtosis for different nonchiral/reversal regimes and Pattanayak et al. for chiral ABP without turns. Their distinct formulas do not imply the strict fourth-rate sign at the second-rate optimum under arbitrary symmetric turn distributions.
